title: FeatConfig
description: feat.config.json — service, adapter, and pipeline configuration. Loaded once per run (INV-8); validated by @mmmnt/feat-runtime loadConfig (ADR-0001).

environment.description: The environment this config verifies (ADR-0016) — a property of the config the run actually used, stamped into evidence bundles by `feat report --evidence`. Deliberately OUTSIDE the derivation-relevant slice: generated suites are environment-agnostic.

response.description: Required only when specs use when:/execute (deliver-only projects omit it); enforced cross-file at parse time (ADR-0009/0011).

commands.description: Command routing (ADR-0009): CommandName -> adapter-specific invocation shape (HTTP: {method, path}; handler: {module, export}). Closed command space: every command used in when:/execute must exist here — validated at parse time.

actors.description: Actor registry (ADR-0012): named actors with adapter-specific auth material (HTTP: headers/token; handler: context object). 'default' names the actor used when a trigger has no as-clause; 'anonymous' is reserved (unauthenticated) and never declared. Closed actor space — validated at parse time.

services.description: User-defined service keys — the only valid prediction targets (INV-7).

convergenceTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait before capturing eventual services. Required when consistency is 'eventual'.

absenceTimeout.description: Optional shorter wait for absence proofs on eventual services (ADR-0014 tuning knob).

moduleSpecifier.description: npm package name or local path; the module must export createAdapter(config) (INV-10, ADR-0001).
